title: P4B-AI Labs
tagline: P4B-AI Labs is a unified platform where developers build and users explore blockchain-powered AI bots. With pre-integrated AI models, crypto APIs, and social login, we're making Web3 bot interactions accessible while ensuring fair revenue sharing for creators.
description:
P4B-AI Labs is revolutionizing the blockchain bot ecosystem by addressing three critical market gaps: 

Key Problems Solved:
1. Fragmented Development Landscape:
- Complex integrations between AI models and blockchain 
- High costs of multiple API subscriptions 
- Time-consuming setup processes

2. Developer Monetization:
- Uncertain revenue paths for Web3 AI applications 
- Lack of centralized marketplace 
- High entry barriers for builders

3. User Accessibility
- Complex wallet connections Scattered bot ecosystem 
- Technical barriers for non-crypto users

Core Features:
1. Unified Bot Platform
- Pre-integrated AI models (GPT-4 and more later) 
- Ready-to-use blockchain APIs (Coinbase CDP, Pyth Network, The Graph, Blockscout, etc) 
- Single API endpoint for all services

2. Revenue Generation System
- Token staking mechanism for usage 
- Fair revenue sharing for bot creators 
- Community-driven marketplace

3. Seamless User Experience
- Social media login integration 
- Natural language interactions 
- Multiple bots in one platform
how_its_made:
1. Authentication & Access:
- Social login integration

2. Core Integrations:
